name: usequery-server-solidjs
description: Server-side query management library for SolidJS with caching and invalidation

scripts.build: bun run build:clean && bun run build:esm && bun run build:cjs && bun run build:types
scripts.build:esm: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --format esm --target node --minify --sourcemap
scripts.build:cjs: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --format cjs --target node --minify --sourcemap --outfile dist/index.cjs

author: Eduard Marbach
